name: memory-hub-plugin
description: Cross-client shared memory hub for AI coding agents: export memories/rules/workflows/session digests (aggregate, redact, incremental) search them read-only from any client, and expose the hub to MCP-capable hosts via a built-in read-only MCP server. 跨客户端共享记忆中台：上行聚合脱敏增量导出，下行只读检索（skill + 内置只读 MCP server）。
